
		<h2>
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19074638" title="发布于 2025-09-05 01:10">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">PocoEmit字典增强功能</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText"><div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一pocoemit集合扩展中支持字典">一、PocoEmit集合扩展中支持字典</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>支持字典互转</li>
<li>支持数组转字典(索引转化为字典主键)</li>
<li>支持列表转字典(索引转化为字典主键)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p>默认集合功能不支持实体属性转字典<br>
为此开发了以下字典增强功能来实现实体转字典</p>
<h2 id="二实体和字典互转">二、实体和字典互转</h2>
<h3 id="1-todictionary">1. ToDictionary</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>实体成员转化为object字典</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">User user = new() { Id = 3, Name = "张三" };
IDictionary&lt;string, object&gt; dic = _mapper.ToDictionary(user);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-gettodictionaryfunc">2. GetToDictionaryFunc</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>实体成员转化为object字典</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var func = _mapper.GetToDictionaryFunc&lt;User&gt;();
User user = new() { Id = 3, Name = "张三" };
IDictionary&lt;string, object&gt; dic = func(user);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="3-fromdictionary">3. FromDictionary</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>object字典转化为实体</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">Dictionary&lt;string, object&gt; dic = new() { { nameof(User.Id), "3" }, { nameof(User.Name), "张三" } };
User user = _mapper.FromDictionary&lt;User&gt;(dic);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="4-getfromdictionaryfunc">4. GetFromDictionaryFunc</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>object字典转化为实体</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var func = _mapper.GetFromDictionaryFunc&lt;User&gt;();
Dictionary&lt;string, object&gt; dic = new() { { nameof(User.Id), "3" }, { nameof(User.Name), "张三" } };
User user = func(dic);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="三实体属性平铺">三、实体属性平铺</h2>
<h2 id="1-createdictionaryconvertfunc">1. CreateDictionaryConvertFunc</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>委托编译生成,重复使用需要缓存</li>
<li>递归转化指定类型成员为字典</li>
<li>支持同类型字典</li>
<li>不支持数组和其他集合</li>
<li>相当于彻底平铺展开</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var func = _mapper.CreateDictionaryConvertFunc&lt;Student, Dictionary&lt;string, int&gt;&gt;();
Student source = new()
{
    User = new() { Id = 2, Name = "Jxj" },
    Age = 17,
    Score = new() { { "语文", 95 }, { "数学", 96 } }
};
Dictionary&lt;string, int&gt; result = func(source);
// result.Count == 4

</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
	"UserId": 2,
	"Age": 17,
	"Score语文": 95,
	"Score数学": 96
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="2-createdictionaryconvertfunc重载方法">2. CreateDictionaryConvertFunc重载方法</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>委托编译生成,重复使用需要缓存</li>
<li>递归转化指定类型成员为字典</li>
<li>支持同类型字典</li>
<li>不支持数组和其他集合</li>
<li>相当于彻底平铺展开</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var func = _mapper.CreateDictionaryConvertFunc&lt;Student, int, IDictionary&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;();
Student source = new()
{
    User = new() { Id = 2, Name = "Jxj" },
    Age = 17,
    Scores = new() { { "语文", 95 }, { "数学", 96 } }
};
IDictionary&lt;string, string&gt; result = func(source);
// result.Count == 4
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
	"UserId": "2",
	"Age": "17",
	"Score语文": "95",
	"Score数学": "96"
}
</code></pre>
<p>源码托管地址: <a href="https://github.com/donetsoftwork/MyEmit" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/donetsoftwork/MyEmit</a> ，也欢迎大家直接查看源码。<br>
gitee同步更新:<a href="https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/MyEmit" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/MyEmit</a></p>
